instructions: Create draft, search reuse, complete source/style/scale fields, adopt only after validation. Technical success is not artistic acceptance.

production.prompt: Identity-preserving production game sprites derived from the attached canonical character. The EXACT adult stocky dwarf cleric Mía: strong male dwarven face, blue eyes, red braided hair, HUGE red beard, chainmail and steel armour, white tabard with gold sun, brown boots, gold sun shield and mace. Do NOT remove beard, feminize, make taller or redesign armour. Shield and mace are deliberately secured on his back/belt when both hands work, not overlaid. Preserve chainmail, tabard and armour in every pose. Eight distinct chronological phases of one natural rightward walking cycle while holding a rolled parchment firmly in the LEFT hand. Right hand swings gently. Smooth leg alternation, no running or sliding. The same person and scroll throughout. No other props. Fixed southeast three-quarter view of hero facing RIGHT, exactly the canonical face, proportions, costume, palette and pixel-painted rendering of the reference, no redesign. A regular EXACT FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, eight complete isolated frames in reading order. ALL figures fully visible inside their cells with generous transparent safety margins. Constant body scale in all frames, shortened crouched silhouette is NOT a smaller person. Landscape 2:1 sheet, each cell contains only the hero. Real transparent background; no ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or text. High detail at native size, ideally 350+ pixels for standing human figure per cell. Do not use old loading-character designs.
